scope: Current Ethereum fxSAVE auto-compounding stability savings, reviewed with its underlying fxSP fixed fxUSD/USDC pool. Seven direct fxSAVE deposit/mint/gauge-deposit/exit/cooldown-claim functions plus four base-pool deposit/exit functions; no router, converter, facet executor, leverage market or arbitrary calldata admission.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Official current landing page offers fxSAVE Auto-Compounding Vault Deposit Now and f(x) 2.0 stability pool. Current mechanism and integration docs explicitly describe fxSAVE and exact saving/base-pool addresses, cooldown and instant exits. Explorer snapshot displays 2026-10-21 requestRedeem and claim and 2026-10-22 harvest transactions. Reviewed sources show no retirement, exit-only, wind-down or team-disbanded notice for these targets. These are lifecycle/maintenance signals, not DAU, vault TVL, fresh runtime/RPC identity or execution proof; frontend placeholder APY/TVL values are not metrics.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official integration Step 1 identifies SavingFxUSD 0x7743...fc39 and Step 2 identifies fxSP 0x65C9...A3be. Ethereum explorer pages and Sourcify chain 1 records bind the deployment chain; implementation constructor binds SavingFxUSD base directly to this fxSP.

sourceSemantics.saving: Deployed SavingFxUSD constructor base=0x65c9a641afceb9c0e6034e558a319488fa0fa3be, gauge=0xed92dde3214c24ae04f5f96927e3be8f8dbc3289. Inherited concrete ERC4626 uses base as asset. _withdraw invokes fixed Convex staking vault withdrawal and sends fxSP; requestRedeem burns fxSAVE and invokes only fixed base.requestRedeem through internally deployed per-user LockedFxSaveProxy; claim invokes fixed base.redeem for that caller. The proxy execute method is NOT a user-admitted target. claimFor requires CLAIM_FOR_ROLE. onHarvest validates configured harvester. harvest itself is permissionless maintenance, not a personal savings action.
sourceSemantics.basePool: Applicable FxUSDBasePool constructor binds yieldToken=fxUSD 0x085780639cc2cacd35e474e71f4d000e2405d8f6 and stableToken=USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. deposit enforces onlyValidToken and minSharesOut, and _deposit enforces the configured depeg threshold. requestRedeem reserves caller shares and resets unlockAt; redeem requires cooldown and returns pro-rata immutable token pair. instantRedeem excludes reserved shares and deducts fee; no-fee variant is role-only.
sourceSemantics.documentationQualification: Official integration prose describes two-step redemption, but precise deployed semantics are preserved: direct fxSAVE redeem returns fxSP synchronously; requestRedeem+claim instead completes underlying cooldown inside fxSAVE and pays fxUSD/USDC. No guessed current fee or cooldown duration is asserted.
